source_grounded_statements: ARMED is a distinct DH02 state: a causally known M1 boundary exists and parent context permits breakout research.
BROKEN requires a completed S5 close beyond the boundary with sufficient frozen volatility-normalized displacement.
ENTRY_ELIGIBLE requires REBREAK_CONFIRMED while spread/session/context rules remain valid.
One boundary plus one original break direction equals one event; repeated ticks do not create duplicate events.
Parent direction/context is M15/M30/H1 via DH01.
All timeframe values and confirmed swings are causal and become available only after completion/confirmation.

bounded_profiles.meaning: 12A leader: no explicit ARMED latch; raw parent context must match at completed-S5 break and again at rebreak/entry.
A newly confirmed M1 boundary becomes ARMED only if raw parent direction matches at that boundary reveal; once armed, break may occur later; raw parent must match again at rebreak/entry.

While idle, the latest causally confirmed unused M1 boundary becomes ARMED the first time raw parent context permits that direction; ARMED remains latched through BROKEN/RETEST; context is rechecked at entry.
Same dynamic ARMED latch, but if raw parent context becomes invalid after BROKEN and before entry, the one-boundary/one-direction event is consumed as context-invalid rather than allowed to continue.

Diagnostic localization only: no parent gate at break/arm; raw parent context required at rebreak/entry. Included to determine whether historical placement could have been primarily entry-side; it is not promoted merely by fit.

selection_rule: Prefer a source-grounded lifecycle interpretation only if it materially improves the preserved S08 population/economic fingerprint without numeric retuning. Exact same-sample fit alone cannot prove missing historical semantics. If no source-grounded profile materially closes both population and winner/loss-tail gaps, freeze 12A as best reconstruction and close S08 as provenance-limited rather than fit thresholds.
